dictionary.title: Overview
dictionary.description: Which models {assistant} is using right now. Changes apply immediately, even during a conversation.
dictionary.last_answer_none: No answer yet in this session
dictionary.usage_no_budget: No limit set for online services.
dictionary.presets_hint: One click to set every task at once. You can fine-tune afterwards.
dictionary.preset_neuro_core_hint: Home models first, then connected servers, then online services.
dictionary.preset_auto_hint: Chooses by itself based on the hardware.
dictionary.preset_private_hint: Home models only: no data leaves your network.
dictionary.preset_balanced_hint: Home first; online services only if nothing at home answers.
dictionary.preset_smart_hint: The most capable online services first, home models as backup.
dictionary.preset_cloud_hint: Uses only the configured online services, no local models.
dictionary.preset_confirm_body: The current choices for every task will be replaced. Provider keys stay unchanged.
